'''''Blizzard 8''''' was the designation given to one of the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] of [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
